note: Ps64 against secret plotters (corrected). Human IB: the complaint (siach) + dread (pachad) of the enemy; the blameless (tam) target; the wicked's secret-plots (sod) + bitter (mar) words + brazen shooting without fear + hold-fast (chazaq) to evil + presume none can see + search-out injustice (the deep heart of man); after God shoots back, mankind FEARS + TELLS + PONDERS God's deed; the righteous REJOICE + TAKE REFUGE + upright EXULT. God-qualifiers=5 (hear/preserve/hide/shoots-his-arrow/brought-about). The tongues/swords/arrows/ambush/snares weapon-imagery + enemies' fate (ruin/wounded/head-wagging) = standalone. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: complaint / lament (siach - hear my voice in my complaint)
driven by dread of the enemy
asking God to hear and preserve his life (v1)

'Hear my voice, O God, in my COMPLAINT (siach)' — the lament of a man beset by secret enemies; siach here the voiced distress the psalmist begs God to hear and answer by preserving his life (the qualifiers) — prayer as the recourse against unseen plots
dread / terror (pachad - dread of the enemy)
the fear that drives the complaint

'preserve my life from DREAD (pachad) of the enemy' — the terror the secret plots inspire; pachad here the fear of the hidden foe, from which the psalmist begs preservation — the anxiety of one shot at from ambush
secret plot / council (sod - the secret plots of the wicked)
expressed in bitter words and laid snares
at which God shoots his arrow (v7)

'Hide me from the SECRET PLOTS (sod) of the wicked' — the hidden conspiracy the psalmist most fears; sod (secret counsel) the covert scheming of the throng of evildoers — malice that works in the dark, until God's arrow finds them (v7)
bitter (mar - aim bitter words like arrows)
like arrows, tongues whetted like swords
the venom of the secret plots

'who whet their tongues like swords, who aim BITTER (mar) words like arrows' — the venomous speech that is the enemies' weapon; mar here the bitterness of their words, tongues sharpened to wound — malice loaded and aimed, shot from ambush at the blameless
blameless / complete (tam - shooting at the blameless)

'shooting from ambush at the BLAMELESS (tam)' — the innocence of the target that makes the ambush the more wicked; tam here the psalmist's integrity — attacked not for any fault but simply as the object of malice, shot at suddenly and without fear

'shooting at him suddenly and without FEAR (yare)' — the brazen fearlessness of the wicked; yare here negated - they shoot with no fear of God or reckoning, the same godless boldness as those who say 'who will hear/see us?' (v5) - malice unrestrained by any dread
hold fast / encourage oneself (chazaq - they hold fast to their evil purpose)
paired with the evil purpose they cling to
until God shoots his arrow at them (v7)

'They HOLD FAST (chazaq) to their evil purpose' — the resolute, mutually-encouraged clinging to wickedness; chazaq here the enemies bracing one another in evil, entrenched in their scheme - a determined wickedness that God's counter-arrow will shatter (v7)
the object they hold fast to

'they hold fast to their EVIL (ra) purpose' — the wicked resolve at the core of the scheme; ra here the evil word/purpose the enemies are set on, the fixed aim behind their talk of snares and search for injustice
the presumption behind the secret snares

'they talk of laying snares secretly, thinking, Who can SEE (raah) them?' — the presumption that their scheming is unobserved; raah here the seeing they deny - the same godless confidence as 'who will hear us?' (Ps59:7) - not reckoning that God sees and searches the deepest heart (v6-7)
injustice / wrongs (olah - they search out injustice)

'They search out INJUSTICE (olah), saying, We have accomplished a diligent search' — wrong devised with painstaking care; olah here the injustice the wicked labour to perfect, boasting of their thorough scheme - evil pursued as a craft
diligent search / plot (chephes - a diligent search)

'We have accomplished a diligent SEARCH (chephes)' — the enemies' pride in their perfected plot; chephes here the thorough scheme they boast completed - the diligence of the wicked mind, and the irony that God's search of the heart (v6b-7) undoes theirs
heart / inner self (leb - the inward mind and heart of a man are deep)
the depth the wicked hide in, yet God pierces (v7)

'For the inward mind and HEART (leb) of a man are deep' — the unsearchable depth of the human interior; leb here the hidden abyss of the self where the wicked lay their secret plots, thinking none can reach - yet God shoots his arrow into that very depth (v7), the heart no man plumbs but God pierces
fear / stand in awe (yare - then all mankind fears)
issues in telling and pondering God's deed

'Then all mankind FEARS (yare)' — awe replacing the wicked's fearlessness; yare here the reverent fear that God's judgment on the plotters awakens in all - the fear the enemies lacked (v4) now falls on everyone who sees his work
tell / declare (nagad - they tell what God has brought about)

'they TELL (nagad) what God has brought about' — the awed proclaiming of God's judgment; nagad here the declaring of God's deed - the fear of v9 turning into testimony, God's work on the wicked published abroad. Qualifier attached: what God brought about (281158)
ponder / consider wisely (sakal - ponder what he has done)

'and PONDER (sakal) what he has done' — thoughtful consideration of God's act; sakal here the wise reflecting on God's judgment - not fleeting fear but a considered lesson drawn, the opposite of the wicked's foolish presumption that none sees
paired with the upright in heart

'Let the RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq) one rejoice in the LORD' — the vindicated upright, over against the fallen plotters; tsaddiq here the God-fearing whose refuge is proven, called to rejoice as the wicked are brought to ruin
rejoice / be glad (samach - rejoice in the LORD)
paired with taking refuge in God

'Let the righteous one REJOICE (samach) in the LORD' — joy grounded in God, not in the enemies' downfall for its own sake; samach here gladness in the LORD himself, the fruit of seeing his justice done - rejoicing that flows into taking refuge in him
take refuge (chasah - take refuge in him)
paired with rejoicing in the LORD

'and TAKE REFUGE (chasah) in him!' — the righteous sheltering in God even as they rejoice; chasah here the refuge-taking that answers the psalmist's plea to be hidden (v2) - the safety the blameless find in God, who shot down the ambushers
upright (yashar - all the upright in heart)

'Let all the UPRIGHT (yashar) in heart exult!' — the straight-hearted, over against the deep-hidden hearts of the plotters (v6); yashar here integrity of heart - the openness before God that is the opposite of the wicked's covert depths, called to exult in his vindication
exult / glory (halal - all the upright shall exult)
the exulting of the upright twinned with the righteous' joy

'all the upright in heart shall EXULT (halal)!' — the glad boasting of the vindicated in God; halal here the exultation of the upright as God's justice is revealed - the psalm's triumphant close, joy answering the dread of v1
God's hearing asked of the complaint (v1)
v1 QUALIFIER (God's act asked): 'HEAR (shama) my voice, O God' - God's hearing is not a human IB char; the attention the psalmist's complaint (281092) seeks. Qualifier.
God asked to preserve the psalmist's life from dread (v1)
v1 QUALIFIER (God's act asked): 'PRESERVE (natsar) my life from dread of the enemy' - God's guarding is not a human IB char; the protection the psalmist's complaint (281092) pleads for. Qualifier.
hide / conceal (sathar - hide me from the secret plots)
God asked to hide the psalmist from the plots (v2)

v2 QUALIFIER (God's act asked, re-roled from an earlier mis-call): 'HIDE (sathar) me from the secret plots of the wicked' - God's concealing/protecting is not a human IB char; the shelter the psalmist's complaint (281092) begs against the hidden conspiracy. Qualifier.
shoot (yarah - God shoots his arrow at them)
God shoots his arrow at the wicked who hold fast to evil (v7)

v7 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'But God SHOOTS (yarah) his arrow at them; they are wounded suddenly' - God's counter-attack is not a human IB char; the divine judgment on the plotters who held fast to evil (281127) - the archers shot down by the God who pierces the deep heart. Qualifier.
do / bring about (paal - what God has brought about)
God's deed, which mankind tells and ponders (v9)
v9 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'they tell what God has BROUGHT ABOUT (paal)' - God's deed is not a human IB char; the judgment mankind declares and ponders (281156). Qualifier.
v1: 'Hear my VOICE (qol), O God' - the sound of the psalmist's crying; the complaint it carries is the char (281092). Standalone (the voice).
wicked / evildoers (raa - the secret plots of the wicked)
v2: 'the secret plots of the WICKED (raa)' - the plotters as persons; their scheming is the char (281107). Standalone (the wicked, persons).
throng / crowd (rigshah - the throng of evildoers)
v2: 'from the THRONG (rigshah) of evildoers' - the noisy crowd of the wicked; the mass of plotters. Standalone (the throng).
v2: 'the throng of EVILDOERS (paal aven)' - the workers of iniquity as persons; their evil purpose is the char (281128). Standalone (the evildoers, persons).
sharpen / whet (shanan - whet their tongues like swords)
v3: 'who WHET (shanan) their tongues like swords' - the sharpening of the tongue for wounding; the bitter words are the char (281117), here the weapon-preparation image. Standalone (image).
v3: 'their TONGUES (lashon) like swords' - the tongue as the weapon of the wicked's speech; part of the sword-arrow imagery. Standalone (image).
v3: 'their tongues like SWORDS (chereb)' - the image of the wounding tongue as a whetted sword. Standalone (image).
aim / bend the bow (darak - aim bitter words like arrows)
v3: 'who AIM (darak) bitter words like arrows' - the drawing of the bow to shoot bitter words; the bitterness is the char (281117), here the aiming image. Standalone (image).
v3: 'bitter words like ARROWS (chets)' - the image of malicious words as arrows shot at the blameless. Standalone (image).
v4: 'SHOOTING (yarah) from ambush at the blameless' - the enemies' attack; the assault on the blameless (the char, 281122), here the shooting image. Standalone (image).
v4: 'shooting from AMBUSH (mistar)' - the concealed position of the attack; the secrecy of the wicked's assault. Standalone (image).
v4: 'SHOOTING (yarah) at him suddenly' - the repeated shooting image, the sudden strike at the blameless. Standalone (image).
v4: 'shooting at him SUDDENLY (pithom)' - the unexpectedness of the attack; ironically answered when the wicked are wounded 'suddenly' (v7). Standalone (the suddenness).
recount / talk (saphar - they talk of laying snares)
v5: 'they TALK (saphar) of laying snares secretly' - the enemies conferring about their traps; part of the secret scheming (the char, 281107). Standalone (the talk of snares).
v5: 'they talk of laying SNARES (moqesh) secretly' - the hidden traps of the wicked; the image of their covert scheming. Standalone (image).
v5: 'laying snares SECRETLY (taman)' - the concealment of the traps; the secrecy of the wicked's plotting. Standalone (the secrecy).
search out / devise (chaphas - they search out injustice)
v6: 'They SEARCH OUT (chaphas) injustice' - the act of devising wrong; the injustice is the char (281138), here the searching. Standalone (the searching).
complete / accomplish (tamam - we have accomplished a diligent search)
v6: 'We have ACCOMPLISHED (tamam) a diligent search' - the enemies' boast of their perfected plot; the completion of the scheme (the char, 281141). Standalone (the boast of completion).
v6: 'a DILIGENT (chephes) search' - the thoroughness of the plotting; the diligence carried in the search char (281141). Standalone (the diligence).
inward part / mind (qereb - the inward mind of a man)
v6: 'the INWARD MIND (qereb) and heart of a man are deep' - the inner part paralleling the heart; the deep interior is the char (281143, the heart), here its twin term. Standalone (the inward part).
v6: 'the inward mind and heart of a man are DEEP (amoq)' - the unsearchable depth of the human interior; the quality that qualifies the heart (the char, 281143). Standalone (the depth quality).

v7: 'God shoots his ARROW (chets) at them' - the image of God's judgment as a shaft; God's shooting is the qualifier (306458), here the arrow-image (their own weapon turned on them). Standalone (image of judgment).
wound / blow (makah - they are wounded suddenly)
v7: 'they are WOUNDED (makah) suddenly' - the enemies struck by God's arrow; the fate of the plotters, wounded as suddenly as they shot (v4). Standalone (the enemies' fate).
v7: 'they are wounded SUDDENLY (pithom)' - the poetic justice, the wicked who shot 'suddenly' (v4) now wounded suddenly by God. Standalone (the reversal).
stumble / ruin (kashal - they are brought to ruin)
v8: 'They are brought to RUIN (kashal)' - the enemies' downfall; their fate, undone by their own tongues. Standalone (the enemies' fate).
tongue (lashon - their own tongues turned against them)
v8: 'with their own TONGUES (lashon) turned against them' - the wounding words recoiling on the wicked; poetic justice, the tongue-sword of v3 turned back. Standalone (the recoiling tongue).
see / look (raah - all who see them)

v8: 'all who SEE (raah) them will wag their heads' - the onlookers witnessing the enemies' fall; ironically, the wicked who thought 'who can see us?' (v5) are now seen by all. Standalone (the onlookers).
wag / flee (nadad - will wag their heads)
v8: 'all who see them will WAG THEIR HEADS (nadad)' - the gesture of derision/dismay at the fallen wicked; the onlookers' response to the judgment. Standalone (the head-wagging).
work / deed (maaseh - ponder what he has done)
v9: 'and ponder what he has DONE (maaseh)' - God's deed, the object of mankind's pondering (the char, 281159); the judgment considered. Standalone (God's deed).
heart (leb - all the upright in heart)

v10: 'all the upright in HEART (leb)' - the heart as the seat of the uprightness; the uprightness is the char (281103, seat=heart), the straight heart over against the deep-hidden hearts of the plotters (v6). Standalone (the seat of uprightness).
